title: Comparatives, superlatives, as … as
en:
Short adjectives: -er / the -est (cheap → cheaper → the cheapest; big → bigger; easy → easier).

Long adjectives: more / the most (expensive → more expensive → the most expensive).

Irregular: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst; far → further → the furthest.

than after comparatives: The new system is faster than the old one. as … as = the same: It's as expensive as last year. It isn't as good as I expected.

Superlative + Present Perfect + ever: It's the best report I've ever read.
ru: Короткие прилагательные: -er / the -est; длинные: more / the most; исключения good–better–best, bad–worse–worst. После сравнения — than. as … as — такой же как; not as … as — не такой как. the best … I've ever … — лучший из всех, что я когда-либо…

boss.situation: Compare two systems, tools or processes you use at work. Which is faster, more reliable, the best? Use as … as once.
samples: The new ERP system is faster than the old one.
It is also more reliable, but it is more expensive.
Excel is easier to use than the ERP system.
The old system wasn't as convenient as the new one.
It's the best tool we've ever had for approvals.

qs.q: This report is ___ than the last one.
It's the ___ expensive hotel in the city.
qs.exp: Superlative of a long adjective → the most.

qs.q: My English is ___ than last year.
Today is ___ than yesterday — minus 25!
She's as tall ___ her brother.
This is the worst coffee I've ___ tasted.
The comparative of “easy” is ___.
Our office is ___ from the centre than yours.
“The new system isn't as fast as the old one” means the old one is faster.
“He is more taller than me” is correct.
Almaty is ___ (big) than Atyrau.
a: bigger
qs.exp: One vowel + one consonant → double: bigger.

qs.q: This is the ___ (interesting) book I've ever read.
a: most interesting

qs.q: Yesterday was the ___ (bad) day of my week.
a: worst

qs.q: The test was ___ (difficult) than I expected.
a: more difficult

qs.q: My car isn't as ___ (new) as yours.
a: new

qs.q: Which is the ___ (busy) month for your team?
a: busiest

a: This task is easier than that one.

a: It is the best hotel in town.
It's the best hotel in town.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He is as clever than his sister.”
a: He is as clever as his sister.
He's as clever as his sister.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “This is the most cheapest option.”
a: This is the cheapest option.
This is the cheapest one.
It is the cheapest option.

qs.q: Новая система быстрее старой.
a: The new system is faster than the old one.
The new system is faster than the old system.

qs.q: Это самый важный проект в этом году.
a: This is the most important project this year.
This is the most important project of the year.
It's the most important project this year.
It is the most important project this year.
This is the most important project in this year.

qs.q: Мой английский лучше, чем в прошлом году.
a: My English is better than last year.
My English is better than it was last year.

qs.q: Сегодня не так холодно, как вчера.
a: Today it isn't as cold as yesterday.
It isn't as cold as yesterday.
Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
It is not as cold today as yesterday.

It isn't as cold today as yesterday.

qs.q: Это лучший отчёт, который я когда-либо читал.
a: This is the best report I've ever read.
This is the best report I have ever read.
It's the best report I've ever read.
It is the best report I have ever read.
This is the best report that I have ever read.

qs.q: Этот вариант дешевле.
a: This option is cheaper.
This one is cheaper.
This variant is cheaper.

qs.q: Какой самый загруженный месяц?
a: What is the busiest month?
Which is the busiest month?

Which month is the busiest?

qs.q: Аудит был сложнее, чем мы ожидали.
a: The audit was more difficult than we expected.
The audit was harder than we expected.
The audit was more difficult than we had expected.
